overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: attendees could see and hear the Aug 19, 2013 meeting despite crowding, and the Board voluntarily moved to a larger room, which the AG commended.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the August 19, 2013 meeting location could not accommodate all members of the public in attendance.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law because individuals in attendance had sufficient access to the meeting.
